production.direction_en: Sable opens the servants’ entrance from inside. A dozen servants wait in the dark, afraid to speak above a whisper.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch6_estate — whispering, soft clock ticks that stop and start | post: bgm_warmth (muted)

commands.speaker: hana_birch
commands.text: They are safe. I thought my hands would shake more.

commands.speaker: sable_wren
commands.text: They did shake. You still opened the door.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: That is often what courage looks like.

commands.speaker: clem_marr
commands.text: There is a row of graves behind this wing. No names. I am coming back for them.
